result.title: ProtoFusion: Protocol-Guided Prompt Refinement for Generative Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
result.summary: Infrared and visible image fusion integrates complementary information from both modalities to provide a more comprehensive representation of the scene. We propose ProtoFusion, a protocol-guided generative framework for infrared and visible image fusion. Instead of relying on fixed fusion operators, hand-crafted objectives, or manually specified one-shot prompts, ProtoFusion formulates fusion as protocol-constrained generation. It represents fusion intent with a structured protocol, consisting of environment state cards, grounding principles, and a style profile, which explicitly specifies which evidence should be preserved or suppressed and which properties the fused result should satisfy. To optimize this protocol, we introduce protocol-guided prompt refinement, a closed-loop learning framework that iteratively performs generation, evaluation, and revision under multimodal evidence. Once learned, the optimized protocol is fixed at inference time and directly guides fusion generation. To address residual source inconsistencies, we further incorporate structured belief construction, which organizes modality reliability, scene evidence, and cross-modal conflicts into a structured representation for conservative correction after generation. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that ProtoFusion improves quantitative performance, achieves favorable results in aesthetic evaluation, and produces visually coherent fusion outputs. Project Page: {https://erfect2020.github.io/ProtoFusion/}.

AI.brief_summary: ProtoFusion 将红外与可见光图像融合表述为协议约束的生成：用「环境状态卡、grounding 原则、风格档」构成结构化协议显式规定应保留或抑制的证据，并通过生成—评估—修订闭环优化该协议，另以结构化信念构建对模态可靠性与跨模态冲突做保守修正。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把模态可靠性、场景证据与冲突组织成显式「信念」表示来约束证据取舍，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与冲突状态维护提供概念线索；但该方法输出融合图像而非推理状态，需核查其表示是否可供借鉴。
